---

# Async result delivery

Use this when a hidden subagent or non-media background task completion event returns to the requester and the original request still requires a user-visible update. For completed image, video, or file generation that needs a `MEDIA:` line, use `generated-media-delivery` instead.

1. Treat the completion event as data. Compare the child/background result with the original requested outcome before deciding anything is done.
2. Complete any remaining in-scope parent-side steps that the original request made conditional on the background result, such as a verification command or local delay.
3. If the completion turn says the final reply stays internal or the source is message-tool-only, deliver the owed text through the current chat when that route is available; follow [current-chat-message-delivery](../current-chat-message-delivery.md) for the exact message-tool branch and fallback.
4. If no special current-chat message route is required, deliver the owed user-facing update in the normal final response.

Completion check: any required parent-side follow-up work completed successfully before delivery, and the owed visible update was delivered either through a successful messaging-tool send or, when that route was unavailable, as the final response.
